messages:
Claire: dropped a new flow for batch export UX + keyboard shortcuts. figma: https://figma.redwood/exports/compact-preview — main ask: avoid accidental huge exports and make the CSV schema predictable :eyes:
Rahul: visually this helps. two immediate asks: 1) move Export behind kebab, 2) show an estimated download size before enqueueing. Users keep clicking Export by mistake when trying to preview
Dani: backend note: we can return a cheap size estimate (rows * avg_row_bytes) quickly. also recommend an export quota per-user so one team doesn't saturate workers
Eve (PM): timeline: small UI changes this sprint, infra quota and rate-limiting next one. confirm modal can be optional if we reduce surface area of Export
Claire: suggested toolbar: Primary = Preview (solid), Secondary = Save selection (outline), Overflow = Export (with submenu: Selected / All / With breakdowns). Export opens an inline panel that shows CSV header sample and estimated size
a11y: keyboard order currently lands on Export first — that's wrong. Tab order must follow visual hierarchy. Also add an aria-live summary when an export is queued: "Export queued: 1,200 rows (~2.4 MB)"
Rahul: copy tweaks: "Export selected vectors (.csv)" and modal CTA "Export (~2.4 MB)". In overflow submenu include "Export previewed rows" too since preview sometimes filters rows
Dani: implementational detail: enqueue as low_priority job by default. If selection > 10k rows, show an explicit warning banner: "You're exporting 12,345 rows (~280 MB). This may take several minutes and be subject to quotas." with Cancel + Proceed buttons
Eve (PM): also want an opt-in telemetry flag for exports that include score breakdowns so infra can track heavy exports separately. Copy for toast/email: "Your export is ready: Download CSV"
a11y: for screen readers, when the inline panel opens focus should move to the first control and read out header sample. Add visually hidden column labels for relevance indicators (e.g., "Relevance: High") and avoid relying on color alone
Claire: small CSV detail: include a top-comment row like "# schema_v=2026-03-22" so downstream parsers can detect changes. also include a column "_vector_length" to make imports predictable across models with different dims
Rahul: good call. Also ensure CSV quoting is standard (RFC4180) and commas in metadata are escaped. We should surface example rows in the inline panel for clarity
Dani: infra will expose a quick estimate endpoint and mark jobs with low_priority. We'll also return a signed download link when job completes and emit progress events for the UI toaster
Eve (PM): consensus: move Export to overflow, make Preview primary, show size + sample header, add schema_v comment and _vector_length column, keyboard/focus fixes, explicit large-selection warning, and telemetry for breakdown exports. Follow-ups: quotas and admin override in next sprint
a11y: will draft NVDA/VoiceOver test cases (panel open readout, focus return, keyboard-only export path). Please add them to the PR checklist
Claire: I'll update Figma with the inline panel, keyboard flows, and CSV snippet. tagging the group when ready :slightly_smiling_face:
Dani: adding infra ticket for estimate endpoint + low_priority export queue
ops-bot: note: exporting large files may trigger storage lifecycle rules; archived exports older than 30 days will be purged unless user selects retention option
Eve (PM): perfect, thanks everyone — closing thread for now
